payload.title: Rust codegen toolchain: Swift, Kotlin, and TypeScript DTO targets
payload.description: Port the DTO generators to Rust, consuming the canonical AST from the Rust schema DSL. Swift and Kotlin output must match the current generators (snapshot-diff against pnpm schema:generate output for the foundation schema). NEW: TypeScript becomes a generated target so the web client (packages/core/react, which stay TS) gets typed DTOs from Rust-authored schemas. Replaces the TS codegen pipeline.
